rules.reason: ARCHITECTURE.md quirk policy — 4xx/5xx plain-text error messages nobody parses are free; status code and headers are still strictly diffed
rules.client_impact: none — clients branch on HTTP status codes for 4xx/5xx responses

rules.reason: ARCHITECTURE.md quirk policy — Go does not use express-session and therefore does not emit connect.sid on local /login or /logout (refresh_token cookie is strictly diffed)
rules.client_impact: none — web and mobile clients use refresh_token and Bearer JWTs, never connect.sid

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — upstream ApiCacheManager can replay another origin's CORS header across cached requests
rules.client_impact: none — Go computes CORS headers per request without cross-origin cache poisoning

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go blocks SSRF private/loopback URLs on custom metadata providers
rules.client_impact: intentional security hardening — blocks SSRF against private network targets

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go redacts raw SMTP errors from non-admin responses
rules.client_impact: none — non-admin clients receive fixed safe failure text without internal SMTP diagnostics

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go answers multi-range HTTP requests properly instead of 200 full file
rules.client_impact: positive — standards-compliant HTTP Range handling for media clients

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go validates SQLite integrity and version before applying backup archive instead of crashing
rules.client_impact: positive — invalid backup archives are rejected cleanly with 400 instead of exiting 1

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go removes the cover file on DELETE cover whereas upstream leaves the orphan file on disk
rules.client_impact: positive — eliminates orphaned cover files on disk

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go filters episode_* / item socket events by user permissions where upstream SocketAuthority lacks filtering
rules.client_impact: intentional security hardening — restricted listeners do not receive unauthorized episode/item events

rules.reason: go-backend/handover.md — Go filters podcast item_added/item_updated socket events from users without podcast library access whereas upstream SocketAuthority broadcasts them
rules.client_impact: intentional security hardening — restricted listeners do not receive unauthorized podcast item events

rules.reason: http.ServeFile/http.ServeContent advertises Accept-Ranges: bytes on image, cover, and file-range responses where Express sendFile/sharp buffer or 416 responses omit it
rules.client_impact: positive — standards-compliant HTTP Range advertisement for media and image clients

rules.reason: Go net/http.ServeContent omits Accept-Ranges on 416 Range Not Satisfiable whereas Express sendFile sets Accept-Ranges: bytes
rules.client_impact: none — 416 responses carry Content-Range: bytes */<size> and clients do not rely on Accept-Ranges on error responses

rules.reason: Go serves .audiobookshelf backup zip archives with accurate application/zip MIME type instead of Express application/octet-stream
rules.client_impact: none — clients download the .audiobookshelf archive via Content-Disposition attachment

rules.reason: Go returns text/plain; charset=utf-8 for the plain text 'Backup path unchanged' 200 response where Express res.send(string) defaults to text/html; charset=utf-8
rules.client_impact: none — clients branch on HTTP 200 status for PATCH /api/backups/path
